grid.projection: +proj=stere +lat_0=-90 +lon_0=0 +R=1737400; x = rho sin(lon), y = rho cos(lon); pixel centres

encoding: uint8 v -> min + v*(max-min)/250; 255 = no data (mast: higher than 20 m)

definitions.sun: 2027 mean visible fraction of the solar disc, observer 2 m
definitions.earth: 2027 mean fraction of time the Earth centre is above the terrain horizon
definitions.both: 2027 fraction of time with sun > 50% of disc and Earth visible
definitions.dark14: median over 2027 landing days of the longest continuous darkness (sun < 10% of disc) in a 14-day mission
definitions.dark6: same for a 6-day mission (Artemis III surface stay)
definitions.slope: median slope of LOLA 80 m DEM over 25 sub-samples (100 m apart) of the 500 m pixel
definitions.mast: optimal mast of 2/10/20 m, as lunar/masts.py: lowest height reaching 90% of the gain in feasible 6-day landing days (2027) available up to 20 m; gain < 10 days -> 2 m
definitions.days14: number of 2027 landing days on which a 14-day mission meets sun >= 70%, longest dark <= 50 h, Earth >= 50% (2 m)
definitions.psr: 1 = never sunlit (disc fraction 0) at any 2 h step of 2027 (proxy for permanent shadow at 500 m)
definitions.days6_m20: days6_m20.bin: feasible 6-day landing days with a 20 m mast, encoded 0..365
definitions.sun_days: number of 2027 landing days on which a 14-day mission (2 m) gets sun >= 70% of the time
definitions.earth_days: number of 2027 landing days on which a 14-day mission sees the Earth >= 50% of the time
definitions.dark_days: number of 2027 landing days on which the longest darkness in a 14-day mission is <= 50 h
definitions.days14_month: days14_month.bin: raw uint8 12x800x800, feasible 14-day landing days per month of 2027 (0..31), not 0..250 encoded
definitions.ok14: ok14_idx.bin uint32 pixel indices that are ever GO; ok14_bits.bin n x 46 bytes np.packbits (big-endian) of the 365-day GO calendar

method: per pixel horizon table (1 deg azimuth, LOLA 80 m DEM + 240 m beyond 80S, out to 150 km, curvature) interpolated at the Sun/Earth azimuth each 2 h; Sun/Earth from JPL DE421 + IAU 2009 lunar rotation
sources: NASA GSFC PGDA LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ, LDEM_60S_240MPP_ADJ (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/90), public domain
JPL DE421 via skyfield-data (public domain); skyfield (MIT)
default_thresholds_note: criterion day-count thresholds default to 60 days (about two months of 2027); adjustable
criterion_levels_note: each level file <id>.wasm: number of 2027 landing days whose 14-day mission meets that criterion level alone (0..365, encoded like other layers)
